meta.title: RabbitControl remote desktop
meta.description: Open a RabbitControl controlled device inside DeepSeek Harness. The panel lists devices from rc-server, connects over the LAN or through the rc-server relay, decodes the peer's H.264 screen with WebCodecs, and returns keyboard and mouse input. The entry sits in the left panel list. It needs a reachable rc-server, a sign-in on the RabbitControl server status panel, and a controlled side that is either directly reachable or registered through signalling.
